The impact function \mathcal{I}(a_{t}, p_{i}, s_{t}) quantifies how individual player actions affect outcomes, modeled as expectation over change in outcome metrics. The valuation metric \mathcal{V}_{\text{def}}(d_{t}) aggregates defensive efforts from binary action indicators, weighted by strategic relevance. Each primitive operates under assumptions of conditional independence and linearity, with failure modes tied to data sparsity and model generalization limits.
